text.title: Product Operations Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example: inputs → procedure steps → final artefact matching the JSON Schema in 02-output-contract.xml. Then: Three-layer agent architecture for Product Ops, prompt patterns for the most common use cases, and critical gotchas. The architecture rule lives in 01-core-rules.xml, the gotchas in 03-failure-modes.xml.

section.title: Inputs (mocked)
section.note: Pulled per `## Prerequisites`; sources cited in `01-core-rules.xml` rationale.

section.title: Step-by-step application
section.note: 1. Preconditions check: all `## Applies If` items satisfied; no `## Skip If` items fired.
2. Inputs gathered from named sources; freshness OK.
4. Artefact produced from `templates/` rendered with real values (see Final Artefact below).

section.title: Prompt patterns

example.title: Weekly portfolio rollup (scheduled)
example.code: Pull from Linear: all teams, last 7 days. From Productboard: feature status changes. From PostHog: top-20 metrics deltas. Produce ops-rollup-<YYYY-MM-DD>.md: 1) shipped this week, 2) at-risk (slip >2 days), 3) blocked >3 days, 4) metric movers >10%. Source-link every line. Skip empty sections. Output to Notion DB id=<xxx>.

example.title: Template enforcement on a new feature
example.note: Template enforcement on a new feature:
example.code: A new entry was created in roadmap. Verify it has: outcome statement, target metric, dependency list, owner, AC. Missing fields -> comment on the entry with a checklist; do not auto-fill.
example.note: Illustrates pr-style-writes-for-agents: the agent comments, it does not write.

example.title: On-demand stakeholder status pack
example.code: Generate a stakeholder pack for <audience: board | exec | engineering>. board -> 1-page TL;DR + 3 risks + 3 wins + ask. exec -> 1-pager + portfolio heatmap. engineering -> release calendar + dependency graph. Use only data from /ops-store/ updated within 48h. If older, write "stale, refresh" and stop.
example.note: Layer 2 subagent; illustrates two-week-ttl-on-insights and stakeholder-update-template-fixed.
